title: Couple Lounging with Drinks in Garden, 1940 Arden Pines Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
around June 1940 at Arden Pines

Barbara and Pete.

I'm drinking coffee and Barbara is going for root beer.

056
description: A relaxed candid snapshot capturing Barbara and Pete seated outdoors on a sunny day in June 1940. Barbara sits in the foreground holding a cut-glass tumbler of root beer, wearing a dark dress with a ruffled white collar, while Pete sits beside her in a plaid collared shirt drinking coffee. Beside them rests a round metal outdoor table sheltered by a large fringed lawn umbrella against a backdrop of trees and succulent groundcover, depicting intimate domestic leisure just over a year prior to the United States entering World War II.
